note: Champion is entered through the stock Training menu. The map uses unnamed quick-cocos nodes, so its first opponent popup is opened with the same stock window arguments as the map touch callback. Hero EXP is setup through the real stock owner; no March/mission/guide state is provisioned. The chest uses MarchWindow.openBox, its stock touch callback method. Guide 6 is completed with real dialogue taps while present; stock may close it on the first tap. Guide 18 remains enabled for Vanguard, not claimed as exercised by this manual-battle scenario. After the level-30 roster genuinely lost, this victory/chest scenario uses the existing declared AwakeningFixture only for prior Aquaris progression (level90/color15); March state, combat results, missions and guides are still earned through their owners. This does not prove roster progression or level-30 balance.

lua:local cards={} local function walk(n) if not n:isVisible() then return end if n:getName()=='layout' then table.insert(cards,n) return end for _,c in ipairs(n:getChildren()) do walk(c) end end walk(xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('battle_select_team'):nodeByName('list_layer')) for _,card in ipairs(cards) do local b=card:getCascadeBoundingBox() __vc.tap(b.x+b.width/2,b.y+b.height/2) end

lua:if not xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('battle_win') then error('vc-march-first-stage-not-won') end local m=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.MARCH) if m.mapInfo.stage_done~=1 then error('vc-march-win-not-committed') end local task=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.TASK).tasks[xyd.TaskType.DAILY][10016] if not task or task.count~=1 then error('vc-march-mission-fact') end

lua:local wm=xyd.WindowManager.get() local w=wm:getWindow('battle_win') local n=w.returnBtn_ if not n then error('vc-no-battle-return') end local b=n:getCascadeBoundingBox() local e={x=b.x+b.width/2,y=b.y+b.height/2} local ls=n._LuaListeners[cc.NODE_TOUCH_EVENT] if type(ls)~='table' then error('vc-no-return-listener') end for _,l in ipairs(ls) do e.name='began' l.listener_(e) e.name='ended' l.listener_(e) end
